name: Round baler
definition: baler that rolls hay, straw or silage into round bales; fixed or variable chamber is an attribute.
notes: Shops list round balers as their own category; split from Baler

name: Large square baler
definition: baler that presses hay or straw into large rectangular bales.
notes: Shops list big square balers as their own category; split from Baler

name: Small square baler
definition: baler that presses hay or straw into small rectangular bales that can be handled by hand.
notes: Shops list small square balers as their own category; split from Baler

name: Rotary cutter (brush hog)
definition: implement whose large blades on a vertical shaft under a deck cut grass, weeds and brush.
notes: Shops list brush hogs apart from flail mowers; split from Rotary cutter and flail mower

name: Grain auger
definition: flighted tube auger that lifts or moves grain, portable or fixed.
notes: Shops list grain augers as their own category; split from Grain conveyor

name: Grain bucket elevator
definition: vertical elevator (grain leg) whose buckets lift grain to a bin or dryer.
notes: Shops list bucket elevators as their own category; split from Grain conveyor
